title: 彭博智库：阿里重金投入AI，回报承压引发市场疑虑
speaker: Robert Leib

segments.en: Well, to carry on with the meteorological theme of depression has entered over the China tech sector, and that's been apparent since Tencent reported, and sort of disappointed expectations, the same with Baidu and now Alibaba.
segments.zh: 延续天气比喻，中国科技板块情绪低迷，自腾讯财报不及预期以来一直如此，百度、阿里也类似。

segments.en: Because I think, you know, whilst Alibaba certainly has a very clear strategy, they talk a good story, this is coming at a very high financial cost to their business.
segments.zh: 阿里战略清晰，故事讲得好，但代价高昂。

segments.en: When they reported results last week, we saw their capex spending went up more than two times sequentially to $10 billion in one quarter alone.
segments.zh: 上周财报显示，资本开支环比增长超两倍，单季达100亿美元。

segments.en: Now, US viewers will no doubt be thinking, well, that's a fraction of what their US counterparts are spending. That's true, but from a very relative low base, it is coming up at a rapid rate, and therefore pressuring their free cash flow.
segments.zh: 美国观众会觉得这只是美国同行的一小部分，但基数低、增速快，对自由现金流形成压力。

segments.en: If you looked at the change in operating profit for that key cloud intelligence business, the change in operating profit year over year, profit in that business went up by $420 million USD. So that's their return at a massive financial cost and investment cost.
segments.zh: 云智能业务营业利润同比增加4.2亿美元，但这是以巨大财务投入为代价的回报。

segments.en: So if you look at the year as a whole, they're clearly going to be spending close to 40 billion on capex this year, and as I said, their quarterly profit is only increased by a fraction of that.
segments.zh: 全年资本开支将接近400亿美元，而季度利润增幅只是其中一小部分。

segments.en: So the ROI really isn't there, and I think what's shot the market is now coming to the market with replacement. Obviously, there's a dilution. It raises questions.
segments.zh: 投入产出比不佳，市场担忧稀释，引发疑问。
